entities.name: The Order
entities.description: A white-aligned military and religious group across Otaria, with human nomad and aven warrior members, split into Northern and Southern branches.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Land where the Order was based.

entities.name: Ancestor
entities.description: Mysterious entity at the center of the Order's beliefs.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: Dangerous artifact the Order sought to destroy.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Repeatedly in conflict with the Order.

entities.name: Teroh
entities.description: Order member who launched a crusade against the Cabal.

entities.name: Eesha
entities.description: Allied with the Cabal to destroy the Mirari; led the diminished Northern Order.

entities.name: Kirtar
entities.description: Participated in pit fights; destroyed the Northern Order's citadel.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Figure whose coming marks a later time.

events.summary: The Order sought out and destroyed dangerous artifacts such as the Mirari, repeatedly conflicting with Kamahl.
events.quote: the Order repeatedly conflicted with Kamahl

events.summary: Eesha allied with the Cabal to destroy the Mirari.
events.quote: Eesha allied with the Cabal to destroy the Mirari

events.summary: Kirtar destroyed the Northern Order's citadel, killing much of its leadership including Pianna and Teroh; the Northern Order largely fell apart.
events.quote: the Northern Order largely fell apart
